The built-in image-generation tool created the Containment-only production
ornament at
`packages/clinical_calendar_presentation/assets/containment_drone_v2/chassis-conduit-bridge.png`.
The approved landscape concept was supplied as the normative style reference.

the protected Variant F raster assets and archived concept artifacts were not

## Final prompt

```text
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production UI chassis ornament sprite for Containment Drone 47-Alpha
Primary request: Create one dense horizontal cybernetic conduit-and-armor bridge ornament matching the material language of the supplied approved concept. It must be a standalone non-interactive housing ornament used between live Flutter panels, not a UI mockup.
Input image: the approved Containment Drone 47-Alpha concept is the normative style reference.
Subject: layered asymmetrical gunmetal hull plates, bundled black conduits, recessed seams, clamp joints, vents, tiny restrained green indicator lights, subtle wear.
Composition/framing: very wide horizontal ornament centered in the image, straight-on orthographic view, fully visible with generous separation from all image edges; no perspective. The ornament should be about 5:1 wide-to-high inside the square canvas and should tile plausibly at its ends.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for removal; one uniform color, no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, or floor.
Style/medium: crisp high-resolution realistic 3D UI raster, dense sculpted Borg-like cybernetic industrial material language consistent with the reference.
Constraints: no text, no icons, no buttons, no calendar content, no people, no logos, no watermark; do not use #ff00ff in the ornament; crisp isolated edges.
```
